basic_info.name: Locus
basic_info.description: Locus is a software solutions provider for global logistics, known for building the world's first Agentic Transportation Management System (TMS) automating the human decisions in delivery and logistics since 2015.Our software suite includes the Agentic TMS, our Dispatch Management System, and our own Digital Supply Chain Officer (DiSCO) - a logistics operating system that orchestrates every mile, channel, and mode autonomously.Powered by the experience of 1.5B+ successful enterprise deliveries, 200+ real-world constraints and real-time data feeds, Locus delivers logistics decisions that are automated and governed by the policies your teams define. The rules and policies are defined by 6 control mechanisms: Explainability, Traceability, Evaluation, Autonomy Levels, Execution Sandbox, and Human-in-the-Loop.Today, Locus supports 300+ enterprises across 30+ countries, including global leaders like Unilever, Nestlé, Phillip Morris International, Heineken, Siam Makro and many more - helping enterprises in retail, CPG and logistics industries navigate real-world volatility, rising cost-to-serve, and omnichannel complexity. The modern, composable, enterprise-grade solutions ensure most clients go-live in weeks, not years. Locus has been recognized by Gartner for seven consecutive years, featured in the 2026 Hype Cycle for Supply Chain Execution and Logistics Technologies, named a Leader in TMS by QKS Group (SPARK Matrix), and ranked #1 in Route Planning on G2.Following our acquisition by Ingka Group (largest IKEA retailer with operations in 30+ countries), Locus continues to operate independently serving global enterprises, now with more resources to pursue our long-term R&D goals.
